result.summary: The home screen of a food delivery app is mostly well laid out. The main visual defect is the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, whose hero image failed to load and shows a broken-image placeholder. There is also a minor overlap issue on the first 'Fastest near you' card.

issues.description: The hero image on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' failed to load. A grey box with a broken-image icon appears in its place, while the neighboring pizza card shows its image correctly. This makes the card look broken and less appetizing.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or loading logic. Add a retry, and show a branded fallback placeholder or skeleton loader instead of the raw broken-image icon.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' time pill on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps the edge of the plate image, and it sits at a slightly different position from the pills on the other cards. The light card background also gives the image little contrast.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time pills consistently at the same inset on every card. Make sure the image does not collide with them, and add a subtle border or shadow to the pill.

issues.description: The secondary grey text ('€0.90 delivery', 'Ramen' and the meta line) and the search placeholder are light grey on a light background, giving low contrast. The white '€0 delivery' pill over the light grey placeholder is also weak.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and placeholder colors to meet WCAG AA contrast of 4.5:1.
